catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Current-source temozolomide assessment; independent review pending

metadata.schedule_summary: 21 days concurrent TMZ/RT, four-week break, then up to six 28-day adjuvant cycles; adjuvant TMZ on Days 1–5, with dose escalation only if eligible at Cycle 2.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Derived from current NCCP 00461 v3, retrieved 2026-11-05, with source-labelled EMA safety supplements. Independent clinical/pharmacy validation pending; not an authorised prescribing system.
source_conflicts: Significant hepatic dysfunction is excluded, although the organ-dose table expects no adjustment in Child-Pugh C. Resolve eligibility with the specialist; this is not treatment clearance.
The NCCP advises men to avoid fathering a child for six months after treatment; the current EMA SmPC says at least three months. The patient needs a confirmed local contraception plan.
The NCCP source does not specify a CTC grading edition. The UI identifies clinician-verified source grades and does not invent a CTCAE v5 nausea Grade 4 category.
Page 1 and the v3 amendment on page 5 specify up to six adjuvant cycles; page 3 Table 3 still says cycles 2–12. The authored plan uses six, with explicit specialist review of any extension.
The adjuvant Tables 4 and 5 retain a concurrent-radiotherapy column heading. The surrounding section establishes the adjuvant context.

The Cycle-2 escalation paragraph permits preceding-cycle nausea/vomiting Grade 3, while the current-toxicity table delays for Grade 3. Previous and current grades are entered separately; escalation remains a prescriber review.

The severe-count stopping table does not explicitly distinguish nadir from next-cycle counts. A severe prior nadir is flagged for attribution review, and a confirmed prior permanent-stop criterion remains active after recovery.
This NCCP indication is explicitly outside its Irish licence. Informed consent and hospital-policy acknowledgement are required.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Current NCCP regimen emetogenic classification; regimen phase/component and local policy must be considered.
other_supportive_care: PJP prophylaxis required during concurrent RT; persistent lymphopenia and steroid exposure need continuing local-policy review.
Source emetogenic class moderate to high oral SACT; use oral temozolomide-day antiemetic plan, not an intravenous Day1-only script.
Swallow intact capsules fasting; never repeat a dose after vomiting.
For an accidentally missed dose NCCP says make up unless next dose due within 12 hours; confirm written pharmacy instructions and never double. Toxicity-related held doses must not be self-replaced.

Fertility/contraception counselling before treatment: NCCP advises men avoid fathering for 6 months; current EMA says at least 3 months. Resolve duration with pharmacy rather than silently shortening Irish advice.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT

administration.note: Includes non-radiotherapy days as prescribed; PJP prophylaxis required. No dose reductions during this phase.

Reference Cycle 1 dose. Cycle 2 may increase to 200 mg/m² only if source eligibility criteria are met; never later escalation if not increased at Cycle 2. Dose reductions/stopping differ between NCCP 00334 and 00461.

monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, blood glucose, HBsAg and anti-HBc (NCCP p2).
FBC weekly in weeks 1–7 inclusive; renal/liver profile 1 and 4 weeks after final RT. Four-week test also serves adjuvant Cycle 1 Day 1. NCCP p2.
Adjuvant FBC, renal/liver profile on Day 1 of each 28-day cycle (NCCP p2).
EMA supplement: Day 22 FBC (within 48 hours) and weekly until count recovery; check liver function after each cycle and reassess later symptoms (SmPC4.2/4.4 pp4,6–7).
Disease imaging and other monitoring according to the individual consultant plan; no fixed MRI or tumour-marker interval is implied.
